chunks: Everything in this book that is narrated from Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Yunus has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah be pleased with him - from Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Yunus.

key_terms.أَبِي: My father, referring to the author of the book (likely Ibn Babawayh)
key_terms.إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ هَاشِمَ: Ibrahim ibn Hashim, a narrator in the chain
key_terms.جَعْفَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يُونُسَ: Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Yunus, a prominent narrator in Shia hadith literature
key_terms.سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Sa'd ibn Abdullah al-Qummi, a key narrator in the chain

ai.seo_question: How is the chain of transmission for Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Yunus narrations verified in this text?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq provides a precise biographical bridge, linking the narrator Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Yunus (a key figure in the Kufan scholarly circle) to the Prophet’s lineage through his father, Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, and the prominent scholar Sa'd ibn Abdullah. This specific isnad highlights the rigorous verification of sources in Shia hadith compilation, ensuring that narrations from the Imams are traced through reliable, well-known transmitters. It underscores the importance of the 'Ahl al-Bayt' network in preserving authentic teachings.
